items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The fella that signed the contract? Yeah. Jaffe, you're on Jaffe.

ctx.x: Oh I don't know that they, they brought those fellas there you see. But now that's what, that's what all the hump was. That was all the kick about. The club didn't want to march behind them. They didn't want to do the, put their own grand marshal there but this little fella there?
The fella that signed the contract? Yeah. Jaffe, you're on Jaffe.

Well he wanted this fella see. But see we should, see my marshal should have led the band, then my second marshal should have led the club. So that's the way we turned out. I have a number one marshal, he leads the procession. And my second grand marshal, he leads the members, the banner. But as he wanted like that, well we let him go head on like that. But we don't, we have, if we're gonna turn out, they didn't like the colors. They didn't like the colors. I told them what don't make any difference, well that we…
